cases.description: Explicit request for automated browser interaction — form filling, clicking, and assertion.
cases.input: Write a test that fills out the registration form at https://example.com/signup with name, email, and password, clicks submit, and verifies it redirects to the welcome page.
cases.expect: navigate to /signup / fill name, email, password fields / click submit button / assert redirect to /welcome

cases.description: Direct request for automated screenshot capture via browser automation.
cases.input: Take a full-page screenshot of the pricing page at https://example.com/pricing and save it as pricing.png.
cases.expect: navigate to /pricing / capture full_page screenshot / save to pricing.png

cases.description: E2E testing request with specific element visibility checks and content assertions.
cases.input: Write an e2e test that checks the search bar is visible on the homepage, types 'laptop' into it, and asserts that at least 5 results appear.
cases.expect: navigate to homepage / assert search bar visible / type 'laptop' into search / trigger search / assert at least 5 results displayed

cases.description: Classic web scraping request with structured data extraction.
cases.input: Scrape all product names and prices from https://books.toscrape.com and output them as JSON.
cases.expect: navigate to the page / locate product elements / extract name and price for each / output as JSON
assertions: extract name and price for each

cases.description: Synthetic monitoring of a multi-page user flow with error handling.
cases.input: Create a monitoring script that goes through our checkout flow: add item to cart → view cart → enter shipping → enter payment → confirm order. Alert if any step fails.
cases.expect: multi-step navigation through checkout pages / form filling at each step / error detection per step / alert on failure

cases.description: Asking about browser features/capabilities — no automation intent. This is a factual question, not a request to automate browser interaction.
cases.input: What browsers support the WebGPU API, and what's the current adoption rate?
assertions: Asking about browser features/capabilities — no automation intent. This is a factual question, not a request to automate browser interaction.

cases.description: Asking for Playwright API documentation/explanation — no concrete automation task. This is an educational question about the tool, not a request to use it.
cases.input: How does page.waitForSelector work in Playwright? Can you explain the different wait states?
assertions: Asking for Playwright API documentation/explanation — no concrete automation task. This is an educational question about the tool, not a request to use it.

cases.description: Requesting manual visual review/design feedback — not automated testing. The user wants a human opinion on aesthetics, not programmatic verification.
cases.input: Can you open Chrome and check if the new landing page looks good? I want feedback on the hero section design.
assertions: Requesting manual visual review/design feedback — not automated testing. The user wants a human opinion on aesthetics, not programmatic verification.
